answer_1.quote: We propose a novel dynamic graph aggregation framework for the task of knowledge graph enhanced dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the metrics of BLEU , NIST , METEOR , Dist, and Ent for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We present manual pair-wise comparisons to examine the appropriateness and informativeness of the most competitive baseline (ConceptFlow), our model (SaBART), as well as two ablation models ... Three human evaluators are instructed to give their preferred response on 100 randomly sampled conversational pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to select the preferred response based on appropriateness and informativeness of the generated reply.
